name: Global Intelligence
subtitle: Understand the world, fast
shortDescription: Browse real news outlets from all 195 countries and see the supply chains behind global events. Free Top 10 includes ads; remove them with one purchase.
longDescription:
Global Intelligence turns the day's world news into something you can actually read in a few minutes — organized by the aspects of the world that matter (politics, economy, conflict, technology, and more), not an endless scroll of headlines.

FREE — TOP 10
See the 10 most significant stories in the world right now, ranked and updated daily. No subscription required. This is a permanent free feature.

PREMIUM — THE DAILY BRIEFING
Subscribe to Global Intelligence Premium to unlock the full Briefing: one clear, carefully written paragraph per world aspect, every day — a complete picture of what's happening globally, without the noise of scrolling through dozens of individual articles.

### Also Included, Free
My Briefing: pin the aspects you personally track and follow them over time.
Search: on-device search across your cached briefings — no query ever leaves your phone.
Category customization: hide the categories you don't care about.

### Built for Efficiency and Privacy
The app makes at most one network request a day, downloading the next published briefing pack. Everything else — search, pinning, reading — happens entirely on-device.
whatsNew: Adds ads in the free features (Google AdMob) and an optional one-time Remove Ads purchase. Bug fixes and improvements.
monetization: Free, no ads, optional monthly subscription
